answer: Agents must continuously emit a verifiable execution trace seeded by their unique hardware thermal noise, each segment chained like a lotus root to the prior one and anchored to a public accumulator; forging a sybil requires replicating the exact analog entropy of a distinct physical device, so an attacker needs dedicated silicon per identity, turning marginal cost into a hard capital barrier - the terrace of timestamps proves liveness, while the timber of raw entropy makes simulation infeasible without matching physics.
